spans.s:
f. (-विः-वी)
The pepper plant or a kind of it.
E.
चर्व to eat, इन् affix; also sometimes ङीष्, deriv. irr.; also चव्य and चविका.

mf. (-कः-का or की)
A plant that yields a sort of long pepper, (Piper chavya.)
E.
चर्व to eat, and क्वुन् affix. र rejected.

nf. (-व्यं-व्या)
A variety of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.)
f. (-व्या)
Orris root.
E.
चर्व to be eaten, ण्यत् affix, and deriv. irr.
